moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 1 on tension 170, friction 26, mass 1 (damping ratio 1.0): no overshoot, within 1 % by ~510 ms. The kit's spring.default is exactly k 170, d 26 (duration 0.51 s). Rule: the reference value when unsure. Small demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: tension (170) · friction (26) · duration (0.51 s). react-spring's default (tension 170, friction 26): critically damped in practice, no overshoot, ~0.51 s. The reference when unsure.
